claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Epicatechin gallate is a polyphenol that at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since its reported anticancer/antiproliferative effects require much higher concentrations (tens of micromolar) and its annotated antibacterial and antiviral activities are not relevant to cancer cell killing.
